While the dikes are in need of repair, no CDBG funds are allotted for this purpose. The United States Army Corps of Engineers has had an ongoing study concerning the levee situation in the Alviso area. Under optimum conditions, improvements might be expected in the mid-1980's.
The following list shows the CDBG funding for Alviso for the 3 year period July 1978 to June 1981.
Project Descriptions: 
Storm Drains and Streets
Fourth and fifth year funds will be used to complete the storm drainage system in Alviso and improve the streets. In the fourth year, funds are provided for completion of the drainage system for the residential area including drainage of State Street (Essex to Spreckles), Wabash Street (Pacific to Spreckles), Michigan Street (Pacific to Spreckles) and Pacific Street (State to Michigan). Street improvements will also be provided on Wabash Street (200' W of Pacific to Spreckles), Michigan Street (Essex to Spreckles) and Pacific Street (State to Grand).
In the fifth year, curbs, gutters, sidewalks and lighting are proposed for all residential streets previously graded and paved in the internal area (not including State, Spreckles, Grand) and Michigan (west of Archer).
Wilson Way
Improvements will include street resurfacing, sidewalks, curbs and gutters to Wilson Way.
Clean-Up Program
Funds will be provided to implement a "clean-up" program in Alviso and the immediate surrounding area. Financial incentives for the removal of junk cars and applicances, large trash bins and advertising would also be provided.
Park Improvements
This project will provide cyclone fencing along Park Avenue and Wilson Way; lighting around the baseball diamond and lights along Wilson Way as needed.
